auth.model: email + password via the backend SDK
rules: signed-out visitors are redirected to /sign-in for protected routes
electricians can only read and modify their own projects and rooms
admins can access /admin and manage users, roles and system settings
electricians manually opening /admin see an access denied guard
demo credentials are displayed on the sign-in screen

routes.name: Sign in
routes.purpose: Email and password sign-in with visible demo account guidance and estimate disclaimer

routes.name: Dashboard
routes.purpose: Protected dashboard showing project count, room count, fittings count and estimated active project value

routes.name: Projects
routes.purpose: Create, search, filter, rename, delete and open lighting projects

routes.name: Project detail
routes.purpose: Manage project rooms, room calculations, layout editor and selected room products

routes.name: Estimate and project summary
routes.purpose: Show fitting quantities, product costs, labour costs, totals, room-by-room summary and export controls

routes.name: Products catalogue
routes.purpose: Search and filter seeded downlight products and select products for rooms

routes.name: Admin area
routes.purpose: Admin-only user, role and system default management

states.empty: no empty state because demo credentials are shown
states.loading: signing in indicator while authentication is in progress

states.empty: zero projects, zero rooms, zero fittings and zero active estimate value are shown
states.error: dashboard data could not load message is visible
states.loading: skeleton cards while project metrics load
states.success: project count, room count, fitting count and estimated active value are visible
states.validation: all metric cards are labelled as design estimates only

states.empty: no projects yet message and create project control are visible
states.error: project save failed message is visible

states.empty: no rooms yet message and add room control are visible

states.loading: loading indicator while rooms and settings load

states.validation: positive dimensions, ceiling height, lux, lumens, beam angle and edge offset are required

summary: A role-based recessed/downlight lighting design and estimating workspace where electricians manage persistent projects, rooms, layouts, products, calculations, estimates and exports, while admins manage users, roles and defaults.

deferred.item: formal lighting compliance or regulatory certification
deferred.reason: the app must clearly label outputs as design estimates only
the requested product catalogue can be represented with seeded persisted products
the fixed scaffold does not add packages; a downloadable CSV or text estimate satisfies export requirements

deferred.item: multi-user company/team sharing beyond owner and admin boundaries
deferred.reason: the request only requires signed-in user ownership and admin administration
the request is for design and estimating, not payment collection

entities.name: appUser
relationships: an appUser corresponds to one authenticated account
admins can create and update appUser role records

entities.name: project
relationships: a project belongs to one signed-in electrician

entities.name: room
relationships: a room belongs to one project
a room may reference one selected product
layout positions belong to the room

entities.name: systemSetting
relationships: room forms read default lux targets
estimate forms read default labour rate

steps.expect: the sign-in form is visible and demo credentials for an electrician and an admin are shown
visibleText: Design estimates only — not regulatory compliance calculations

the project list, create project control, search control and status filter are visible
the new project appears in the projects list with status Active
the project detail page shows the project name, status and room creation controls

journeys.title: An electrician signs in and creates a persistent lighting project

the project opens at /projects/:projectId

steps.expect: the project detail page shows the room list and add room form

steps.action: change the number of fittings and recalculate the layout
steps.expect: the room diagram updates to show eight proposed downlight positions

steps.expect: one additional downlight marker is visible on the diagram

steps.expect: the sign-in form is visible with demo credentials displayed

the dashboard opens without admin navigation

acceptance.statement: a signed-in electrician can create a project and reopen it at /projects/:projectId after a full page reload
dashboard cards show project count, total rooms, total fittings and active estimated value labelled as design estimates only
room area, lumen requirement, required fitting count, layout rows and columns, spacing and warning outputs are visible after creating a room
